fields.doc: healthProbeBindAddress is the TCP address that the controller should bind to for serving health probes It can be set to "0" or "" to disable serving the health probe. Defaults to ":8081".

api_types.doc: ControllerConfigurationSpec defines the global configuration for controllers registered with the manager.

fields.name: GroupKindConcurrency
fields.doc: groupKindConcurrency is a map from a Kind to the number of concurrent reconciliation allowed for that controller. When a controller is registered within this manager using the builder utilities, users have to specify the type the controller reconciles in the For(...) call. If the object's kind passed matches one of the keys in this map, the concurrency for that controller is set to the number specified. The key is expected to be consistent in form with GroupKind.String(), e.g. TrainJob.trainer.kubeflow.org. Defaults to empty map, which means no limits.

operator_config.name: AddToScheme
operator_config.doc:
AddToScheme adds all types of this clientset into the given scheme. This allows composition
of clientsets, like in:

	import (
	  "k8s.io/client-go/kubernetes"
	  clientsetscheme "k8s.io/client-go/kubernetes/scheme"
	  aggregatorclientsetscheme "k8s.io/kube-aggregator/pkg/client/clientset_generated/clientset/scheme"
	)

	kclientset, _ := kubernetes.NewForConfig(c)
	_ = aggregatorclientsetscheme.AddToScheme(clientsetscheme.Scheme)

After this, RawExtensions in Kubernetes types will serialize kube-aggregator types
correctly.

operator_config.name: AnnotationMetricsPollInterval
operator_config.doc:
AnnotationMetricsPollInterval specifies how often to poll metrics (supports duration format).
Accepts: "30s", "1m", or integer seconds "30" (min: 5s, max: 300s)
Default: 30s
Example: trainer.opendatahub.io/metrics-poll-interval: "45s"

operator_config.name: AnnotationMetricsPort
operator_config.doc:
AnnotationMetricsPort specifies the port where the training pod exposes metrics.
Default: 28080. Valid range: 1024-65535 (non-privileged ports).
Ports 0-1023 require root privileges and are incompatible with OpenShift
restricted SCCs and Kubernetes non-root security policies.
Example: trainer.opendatahub.io/metrics-port: "8080"

operator_config.name: AnnotationProgressionTracking
operator_config.doc:
AnnotationProgressionTracking enables/disables progression tracking for a TrainJob.
Value: "true" to enable tracking, any other value or absence disables it.
Example: trainer.opendatahub.io/progression-tracking: "true"

operator_config.name: AnnotationTrainerStatus
operator_config.doc:
AnnotationTrainerStatus stores the JSON-encoded training status/progress.
This annotation is automatically updated by the controller with real-time metrics.
Example: trainer.opendatahub.io/trainerStatus: '{"status":"training","progress":{"percent":45.2},...}'

operator_config.doc: ControllerPodLabelComponent is the label key for component identification.

operator_config.name: ControllerPodLabelComponentValue
operator_config.doc:
ControllerPodLabelComponentValue is the expected value for the controller component label.
RHOAI uses "controller" (set via kustomization.yaml).
Upstream Kubeflow uses "manager" (set in base/manager/manager.yaml).
This value must match your deployment's controller pod labels.

operator_config.name: ControllerPodLabelName
operator_config.doc:
ControllerPodLabelName is the label key used to identify the controller pod.
NetworkPolicy uses this to allow controller access to training pod metrics.

operator_config.name: ControllerPodLabelNameValue
operator_config.doc:
ControllerPodLabelNameValue is the expected value for the controller name label.
Must match the label applied to controller pods in deployment manifests.
RHOAI: Set via kustomization.yaml labels overlay.

operator_config.name: DefaultMetricsPollIntervalSecs
operator_config.doc: DefaultMetricsPollIntervalSecs is the default interval (in seconds) for polling training metrics.

operator_config.name: DefaultMetricsPort
operator_config.doc: DefaultMetricsPort is the default port for metrics endpoints in training pods.

operator_config.name: MaxMetricsPollIntervalSecs
operator_config.doc: MaxMetricsPollIntervalSecs is the maximum allowed poll interval to keep tracking responsive.

operator_config.name: MinMetricsPollIntervalSecs
operator_config.doc: MinMetricsPollIntervalSecs is the minimum allowed poll interval to prevent excessive controller load.

operator_config.name: PreStopBufferSecs
operator_config.doc:
PreStopBufferSecs is added to (2 × poll interval) for preStop hook duration.
This ensures at least 2 poll opportunities after training completion.

operator_config.name: TerminationGraceBufferSecs
operator_config.doc:
TerminationGraceBufferSecs is added to preStop duration for pod termination grace period.
This allows time for graceful process shutdown after preStop hook completes.

operator_config.name: jsonSanitizer
operator_config.doc:
sanitizeJSON replaces NaN and Infinity values with null in JSON strings.
Python's json.dumps() allows these by default, but they are not valid JSON,
causing Go's json.Unmarshal to fail.
jsonSanitizer matches quoted strings (to skip them) or bare NaN/Infinity tokens (to replace).
By matching strings first, NaN/Infinity inside string values are preserved unchanged.

webhooks.name: validator.clustertrainingruntime.trainer.kubeflow.org
webhooks.purpose: Validates ClusterTrainingRuntime resources on create and update by ensuring the replicated jobs in the runtime spec are well-formed, and emits a deprecation warning on create if the runtime is marked as deprecated via labels.

webhooks.name: validator.trainjob.trainer.kubeflow.org
webhooks.purpose: Validates TrainJob resources on create and update by resolving the referenced runtime (e.g., ClusterTrainingRuntime) from an in-memory registry and delegating validation to that runtime's ValidateObjects method, rejecting requests that reference an unsupported runtime.

webhooks.name: validator.trainingruntime.trainer.kubeflow.org
webhooks.purpose: Validates TrainingRuntime resources on create to ensure that replicated jobs with ancestor labels (trainer, model-initializer, dataset-initializer) always have exactly 1 replica and contain the required named container for that ancestor role (e.g., 'node' for trainer, 'model-initializer' for model-initializer, 'dataset-initializer' for dataset-initializer).
